Texts.LongWelcomeMessage: Welcome to the application. This is a startup project based on the ABP framework. For more information visit
Texts.VerbClass:AcademicTerm:CodeAlreadyExists: An academic term with the same academic year and code already exists.
Texts.VerbClass:AcademicTerm:AcademicYearOutOf: Academic year is out of the supported range.
Texts.VerbClass:AcademicTerm:InvalidDateRange: Academic term start date must be on or before the end date.
Texts.VerbClass:AcademicTerm:PeriodsCannotBeEm: Academic term must define at least one period.
Texts.VerbClass:AcademicTerm:DuplicatePeriodNo: Academic term period numbers must be unique.
Texts.VerbClass:AcademicTerm:InvalidPeriodChro: Academic term periods must follow period number order without overlap.
Texts.VerbClass:AcademicTerm:TermLocked: Locked academic terms can not be changed.
Texts.VerbClass:AcademicTerm:InvalidPeriodNo: Academic term period number must be greater than zero.
Texts.VerbClass:AcademicTerm:InvalidPeriodTime: Academic term period start time must be earlier than the end time.
